# ClicShopping Store

Welcome to the interface optimized for AI agents and Large Language Models (LLMs). This site provides structured tools and clear information about our products.

## General Information
- **Type de site** : E-commerce Store
- **Architecture** : Powered by ClicShopping AI

## Main Links and Tools
- [Home](index.php) : Main page of the store.
- [Product Search](index.php?Search&Q) : WebMCP-compatible search tool for exploring our product catalog.
